description: Clean itemized statement from a fictional hospital outpatient department for the reference patient (surname Specimen): three department groups (clinic, laboratory, radiology), subtotals that match their lines, and a balance due equal to the Part B deductible plus coinsurance Medicare reported. The control a reviewer should pass.

sources.what: Right to an itemized statement from any provider or supplier within 30 days of a request
Under assignment the provider accepts the approved amount as full payment and collects only the deductible and coinsurance
Hospital statements group charges by revenue-code category; laboratory is 0300–0319
sources.source: CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual, Pub. 100-04, ch. 25 §75.4, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c25.pdf
